[0:00] Do you have a toilet that runs continuously or that turns on and off all the time? If so, it's almost always one of three common problems that causes these issues. Come back 10 to 15 minutes later and if the water level is lower, then you know that there's a problem with your flapper.

[2:06] Okay. Now, let's talk about a toilet that runs constantly. First thing to check is check your water level in relation to the fill tube. If the water level is at the top of the fill tube or even a little bit higher, then that's going to cause the toilet to run constantly. So, what you need to do is adjust it. All toilet fill tubes are going to have an adjustment. A lot of them have a little turn dial like this. If you turn it clockwise, you're going to raise the level.
